meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能调用工具在多个学术平台按关键词、作者或主题搜索论文，并返回结果。
howto.when: 当用户提到“搜索论文”“查找研究论文”“搜索 arXiv”等关键词，或要求查学术文献时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜 arXiv 上近期的 Transformer 论文。
say.note: 会按平台返回预印本列表。

say.text: 在 PubMed 查找关于糖尿病的研究论文。
say.note: 返回生物医学相关文献。

say.text: 按作者搜索 IEEE 上关于 5G 的论文。
say.note: 返回该作者在 IEEE 的收录记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use paper-search tools to search academic papers across multiple platforms (arXiv, PubMed, IEEE, etc.) by keywords, authors, or topics and return results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user mentions 'search for papers', 'find research papers', 'search arXiv', or similar phrases about academic literature.

say_en.text: Help me search recent Transformer papers on arXiv.
say_en.note: Returns preprint list from that platform.

say_en.text: Find research papers on diabetes in PubMed.
Search IEEE papers by author about 5G.
